People Ops: Quick heads-up — we're running a 5-day compliance push next week to close out outstanding training modules and to collect control artifacts for our SOC2/ISO readiness drive. Please read through and act: deadline = Friday 11:59pm PT. :calendar:

People Ops: What we need from you: 1) Complete the new 12-min Data Handling micro-training (link below) 2) Upload any outstanding evidence or a placeholder note for each control you own 3) Tag your manager when you’re done so we can verify. Office hours for artifact help are Tue/Wed 10:00–14:00 PT.

People Ops: Links — training: https://internal.redwood/training/data-handling-2026  upload form: https://internal.redwood/forms/comp-upload  docs folder: https://drive.redwood.com/compliance-locker

Devin C.: Quick Q — does this include contractors? I have two contractors who touched feature flags last month.

People Ops: Yes — contractors with prod access or who handled customer data must complete the training and/or have an assigned evidence owner. If you're not sure, mark them in the upload form and we'll triage.

Maria G.: If we don't have a final log archive yet can I add a placeholder? I can show a ticket with ETA.

People Ops: Yep — please use "placeholder: in-progress" and paste the ticket link + expected delivery date. Use the subject pattern CC-<control_id> in the form so reviewers can map items quickly. Example: CC-7b-authz - placeholder - #12345

People Ops: Small checklist (paste into your upload notes if helpful):
```
- Module completed? Y/N
- Evidence uploaded? link or placeholder
- Owner assigned (email)
- Control ID in subject (CC-<id>)
- S3 artifact naming: redwood_s3_YYYYMMDD_<service>_logs.zip
```

Ana M.: Will missing/not-ready items block releases? I'm about to ship a small perf tweak.

CISO Lia: Short answer: no blanket release block. We'll escalate high-risk gaps to Eng Leadership and patch priority items. Routine placeholders won't stop launches but we need visibility.

People Ops: Also, if you are a manager: please run the manager verification checklist in the form after your report completes uploads. We rely on you to confirm coverage. :white_check_mark:

compliance-bot: Automated reminder queued — 48 hours left before the Friday 11:59pm PT deadline. Please check the upload form for outstanding items. :bell:

Devin C.: Thanks — attending the office hours Tue 10:30 to walk through S3 export naming.

Maria G.: Assigned owners for my team's controls and uploaded placeholders for two items. Leaving links in the form. :eyes:

People Ops: Perfect — thanks everyone. If you hit any blockers ping this thread or DM People Ops. We'll post an end-of-week summary on Friday with a short risk digest for leadership. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
